description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commands, specifically focusing on 'git reset' options '--merge' and '--keep'. It contains a series of test cases that manipulate repositories, check the effects of reset commands under various conditions, and verify expected behaviors.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case expected to pass.
methods.parameters: a descriptive string and commands to execute

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs commands that are expected to fail, fails the test if they do not.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock used by tests to simulate time passing.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a given path does not exist in the filesystem.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Checks that a given path exists and is a file.
